title: Staff Logger
description: Logs all commands and chats from your servers staff
body:
# Overview

Staff logger is a super lightweight plugin that records messages and commands sent by server staff and records them into a text file. This is an essential plugin to have in order to minimise staff abuse and keep track of what your staff are doing.

For support, please message me on discord @broomestick

**Features**

Records all commands and messages sent by staff
You can toggle what is recorded
Saves to a new text file daily

**Installation**

Download Staff logger and place it into your server plugins folder
Start the server
Add the permission to your staff group / individuals
You will need a permission manager plugin such as luckperms.

**Permissions**

Staff permission: staff.log

/stafflog reload- reloads the plugin
